title: I made Roadster Jump, an Arcade driving game using cold-gas thrusters!
author: fx599
selftext:
I just released my game **Roadster Jump**.

You drive a sleek electric roadster down the highway. Your car has ten cold-gas thrusters, so one tap hops you clean over the traffic. In the air you can barrel-roll, flip and spin before you land.

  
**Game Modes:**

* **Zen Drive**: no score and no pressure, just cruise and hop
* **Chase**: follow a drone you can never catch and see how long you keep up
* **Auto-drive**: the car drives itself, so you can use it as a relaxing focus timer

It also has daily goals and a streak, and the 3D is rendered on the GPU so it runs smoothly.

▶️ **Google Play:** [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uaua.roadster\_jump](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uaua.roadster_jump)

🍎 **iOS** is in review with Apple and should be out soon.

I’d love feedback, especially on how it runs on your phone. Thanks for checking it out
